thread:
Maya R: passing to evening team — quick handoff summary and action items. had a noisy autoscaler / embeddings spike at ~14:20 UTC that led to degraded embed throughput for eu-west-2 for ~23m. customer-facing impact: increased p95 for embeddings (~1.2s -> ~3.8s) and a small increase in API 429s for heavy batching clients. we mitigated by throttling batch-allocations and routing new requests to us-east as fallback. overall customer impact limited; critical customers routed to dedicated capacity. :wave:

Liam: noted. I'm primary for this shift. secondary is Noor. coverage gap: APAC night is only on-call for another 2h — we don't have a dedicated APAC secondary tonight. tagging product teams for awareness.

Noor: saw the alerts. autoscaler oscillated because of a runaway request pattern from a partner that sent large batch requests with long contexts. I pushed a temporary rate-limit rule on the embedding ingress LB (rule id: rl-emb-77) to cap concurrent batches to 40. that dropped the pressure.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: embeddings-autoscaler-pulse (sev2) — triggered 1761234105. Symptoms: embedding latency p95 spike, host eviction chatter. Actions taken: autoscaler scaled up 3 nodes -> backpressure -> oscillation. Current state: mitigations active (ingress throttle + routing fallback).

Maya R: current status we want to hand over: mitigation in place, evictions reduced, no active pager. still seeing elevated latencies for long-context batches. key next steps for evening:
- confirm capacity stabilization (monitor host evicts and GPU utilization for next 30m)
- keep RL rule in place until we can deploy a client-side backoff or patch to embed-ingress that smooths queuing
- schedule follow-up postmortem w/ partner to tune batching defaults

AJ: putting runbook pointers here: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings/autoscaler-oscillation and the quick rollback snippet if we need to revert the throttle rule:

```
# revert throttle
curl -X POST "$RUNBOOK_API/throttles/rl-emb-77/revert" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

also note the dashboard panel to watch -> EmbeddingIngress/queue-depth and GPU/node-evictions.

Liam: can someone drop the short playbook steps here for primary/secondary actions? Noor, can you list your checks so secondary can verify quickly if I get paged?

Noor: quick checklist for secondary:
1) check /metrics -> emb_ingress_queue_depth and p95 embeddings
2) check host evictions: `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide` and `kubectl describe pod <evicted-pod>`
3) verify throttle rule still applied: `rbctl list thottles | grep rl-emb-77`
4) ensure fallback routing is healthy: `curl -s https://router-status/redwood | jq .fallbacks`
5) if new 500/429s spike, flip routing policy to prefer dedicated for affected tenants (see runbook step 4)

Maya R: FYI I already notified two affected customers (cust-alpha, cust-zet) and they acknowledged. No SLO breaches yet but on close watch.

deploy-bot: Deploy 1761234600 completed (embed-ingress patch) — note: that change is a small queue smoothing tweak, not live for all regions. Canary in us-east only.

Liam: good to know. keep an eye on canary metrics — if the canary reduces queue depth without causing evictions we can roll out.

Noor: I will watch the canary and run the canary-health check every 10m for the next hour. if canary causes CPU pressure, rollback using the snippet AJ posted.

AJ: logging note — collected core dump from one of the evicted pods and uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/diag/1761234567/ with tag `eviction-core-176123`. linking it here for postmortem.

Maya R: outstanding action items for evening shift:
- Liam (primary): monitor canary and queue depth; escalate if evictions resume or p95 > 5s
- Noor (secondary): keep the throttle rule in place and validate fallback routing every 10m; prepare rollback cmd if canary degrades
- AJ: create postmortem checklist and calendar invite for partner sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC

Liam: ack. I'll add a pin to the channel with the current dashboards and the relevant runbook sections.

Noor: taking on the 10m checks now. ping me @Liam if anything odd.

Maya R: tagging SRE lead @AJ for any follow-up budget approval if we need extra reserved capacity for the partner. thanks team — handing off. :handshake:
